answer_1.quote: We introduce the DialoguE COntradiction DEtection task (DECODE) and a new conversational dataset containing both human-human and human-bot contradictory dialogues... provide evidence for its usage in both automatic checking and improving the consistency of state-of-the-art generative chatbots.

answer_2.quote: Using our same DECODE contradiction classifier as the automatic metric... we observe that by re-ranking the beam of beam search (size 10) we can improve the metric.

answer_4.quote: All the dialogues in the set, with either contradiction or non-contradiction labels, are verified by 3 additional annotators, beside the human who actually talked to the bot.
answer_4.guideline: We ask workers to mark the utterance if the bot generates an utterance that contradicts itself. In some of the dialogues, workers are explicitly instructed to goad the bots into making contradicting utterances.
